newsitem.title: JAPAN: Union Tool applies to TSE for 2nd section listing.
newsitem.headline: Union Tool applies to TSE for 2nd section listing.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange said on Tuesday that specialty drill maker Union Tool Co has applied for listing on its second section.
The firm's listing is expected on September 25, the exchange said in a statement. Union Tool, established in 1960, has been listed on the over-the-counter market since June 1989.

The firm's sales in fiscal 94/95 ended in last November totaled 8.0 billion yen, while parent current profit reached 1.8 billion yen. Sales for fiscal 95/96 are forecast at 8.8 billion yen, and current profit at 2.0 billion yen, according to the TSE statement.
